task: Select a real request and map these requested fields for page-number collection. Use JSON Pointers. Page numbers start at 1 and increment by 1. Set pagination_location to the observed page-number location: "query" for GET, "json_body" for a POST JSON body. Values in response_shape or request_body_shape are type placeholders, not actual response values. Reference cases are hints only; actual observations take precedence. Never invent paths or parameters from a case.

reference_cases.title: 顶层列表与明确结束标记
reference_cases.guidance: For a page-number GET response with items, has_next and total: inspect /items, /has_next and /total. Map each requested field relative to an actual item. Use only query parameters present in the observed request. Verify total and unique identifiers across pages.

reference_cases.title: 别名字段映射
reference_cases.guidance: A rows array may use sku and title where the requested outputs are id and name. Confirm observed types and meaning before mapping. The page parameter may be p. Use /more or /total only when present. Never copy an example request identifier.
